testing location
Here you are, Player, in the testing location, a place in which things are tested.

In this test, we will apply "Move Character ToSwitchWith otherchar" to two NPCs, rather than the player.

(Type TEST ME to run the test.)  Bob is here, lounging around, only vaguely aware of what fate will soon befall him.    

> test me
POOF! With a swish of your hand, you switch out Bob and Test Character!
